entity.name: SceneView
entity.description: SceneView is a community-maintained open source project, started in 2021 as the successor of Google's discontinued Sceneform. It has no legal entity of its own: it is fiscally hosted by Open Source Collective, a US 501(c)(6) non-profit that holds the project's funds, signs agreements, issues invoices and publishes every incoming contribution and every expense on a public ledger. Funds are never paid to an individual maintainer; they pay for what the project consumes (build and test infrastructure, test devices, maintenance tooling, security work).

projects.name: SceneView
projects.description: Open source 3D and AR SDK for Android (Jetpack Compose, on Filament and ARCore), Apple platforms (SwiftUI, on RealityKit and ARKit) and the web (Kotlin/JS on Filament.js), with Flutter and React Native bridges and an MCP server that lets AI coding assistants produce working 3D and AR code. Apache-2.0, published on Maven Central, Swift Package Manager, npm and pub.dev. 48 contributors since 2021; used in production apps and public samples by companies in payments hardware, security cameras, accessibility and spatial computing.

channels.description: Preferred channel. Fiscal host: Open Source Collective (US 501(c)(6)). Card, bank transfer, invoice and purchase order; grant agreements are signed by the fiscal host. Ledger is public.
Bank transfer against an invoice issued by Open Source Collective on behalf of the SceneView collective (reference: opencollective.com/sceneview).

plans.name: One year of maintenance and security hardening
plans.description: Covers one year of what the project consumes: release, build and device-test infrastructure; test devices for ARCore and ARKit; maintenance tooling; and a security pass on the code that parses untrusted 3D files (glTF/GLB, USDZ, 3MF) plus signed, provenance-attested releases on Maven Central, npm and Swift Package Manager.

plans.name: Gold sponsor (3 places)
plans.description: For companies that ship SceneView. Everything in Silver, plus your logo in the documentation sidebar and at the top of the README, and a thank-you line in the notes of each major release. Also 5,000 USD a year by invoice. Not a support contract: no private features, no early access, no priority on issues.

plans.name: Silver sponsor
plans.description: Everything in Bronze, plus your logo on the website home page and on the Sponsors screen of the SceneView demo apps. Also 2,500 USD a year by invoice. Not a support contract: no private features, no early access, no priority on issues.

plans.name: Bronze sponsor
plans.description: Your logo and link on the sponsors page of the website and in the README. Also 1,000 USD a year by invoice. Not a support contract: no private features, no early access, no priority on issues.
